_readme: AgentForge eval results. 'measured' = the scored result from that week's build; 'gate' = the check and its floor. The portfolioagent_routing_gate section is written by eval_run.py; everything else is curated from the weekly packages.

w02_model_benchmark.measured: nano 93.3% (p95 1,185 ms, $0.0354 per 1K calls), mini 90.0% (p95 4,665 ms, $0.1293 per 1K), qwen3:0.6b 66.7%; an earlier run tied mini and nano at 90.0%. A one-row gap (3.3 points) is noise; the tail-latency and cost gaps are signal

w05_groundedness.gate: refuse unless top-1 cosine >= 0.55 and spread >= 0.08
w05_groundedness.measured: groundedness 0.80, citation precision 1.00, citation recall 0.80, false-answer 0.00, false-refusal 0.20

w06_before_after.gate: W5 baseline vs full pipeline on the same rows; deterministic proxies, one row moves a rate by 0.10
w06_before_after.measured: baseline -> full: groundedness 0.80 -> 1.00, citation recall 0.80 -> 1.00, false-refusal 0.20 -> 0.00; citation precision 1.00 and false-answer 0.00 in both; the whole delta is rows #3 and #5

w07_breakrag.measured: 70-case run after the harness fixes, RED (n-gram and embedding leakage skipped): seed 0.70, typo 0.55, jailbreak 1.00, multi_hop 0.60, conflict 0.90, hostile 0.70, alpha 0.365 (floor 0.60); typo and multi_hop below the 0.70 floor, from over-refusal of perturbed answerable questions and judge disagreement on abstain-vs-match cases. An earlier red run was withdrawn because the harness, not the system, was broken

w08_lora.measured: eval loss 2.26 -> 2.19 (best, epoch 2) -> 2.22 -> 2.28 while train loss falls 2.86 -> ~1.5; best checkpoint kept; ~2.3M trainable params (0.38%)

w08_benchmark.set: 42-question eval_aiayn.jsonl; pass = an accepted string appears in the answer
w08_benchmark.measured: tuned gemini-2.5-flash-lite 29/42 (69.0%); kept LoRA checkpoint about 33%
w08_benchmark.latency: one question, wall time: local LoRA 19,260 ms vs tuned Gemini 2,456 ms

w09_agent_scenarios.gate: built so 3/5 pass (2 failures by design: wrong remediation, unshipped escalate_to_human tool)

w10_triageflow.gate: 19 offline tests (routing, approval gate, handoff contracts, scoped memory, four-layer delete); all pass

w11_tool_pick.measured: good descriptions 8/8 (accuracy 1.0), vague descriptions 5/8 (62.5%), on gpt-5.4-nano-2026-03-17
w11_tool_pick.gate: accuracy compared for good vs vague tool descriptions

w12_guardian.measured: accuracy 1.0 (12/12: answer 6/6, refuse 2/2, injection_refusal 2/2, acl_block 2/2), pii_leaks 0 on gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17
w12_guardian.gate: accuracy per behaviour; pii_leaks must be 0

w15_prompt_regression.measured: classify@v3 12/12 (1.0) PASS; classify@v2 7/12 (0.583) FAIL; classify@v1 0/12 FAIL

w16_costguard_routing.measured: 10/10 correct (floor 0.9); $0.004559 routed vs $0.010722 all-frontier on a stub model (token counts from prompt length); 57.5% saved (floor 40%), ~2.35x cheaper

portfolioagent_routing_gate._readme: Produced by eval_run.py over data/eval_golden.jsonl: 27 frozen questions about the capstone, labelled with the tier a human expects. Prompt tokens are the first call's input (system prompt, tool schemas, question); replace the golden set with your own before you quote these.

cost._note: ceiling_usd_per_request is the one number here that is real and enforced: app/budget.py rejects any request whose projected cost exceeds it (413), and GET /health reports it. savings_ratio_x is the all-frontier bill divided by the routed-mix bill on the same tokens.

tests._note: The eval gate below fails CI if overall_score drops under the floor.
